natural_body: 40% SMB discount: signup +31%, revenue +18%, but retention -12%; no renewal.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates onboarding simplification improved completion, time-to-value, adoption, and SMB activation. Verify the onboarding result and the pricing trade-off before committing; aggressive discounting previously increased near-term revenue but damaged retention, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.
